## Multica issue link (required)

Every code PR **must** link its Multica issue. Do not open or merge a PR without this.

- **Title:** start with the issue key, e.g. `LCOW-7: short summary`
- **Body:** include a close-intent line on its own (or immediately after a closing keyword):

```text
Closes LCOW-7
```

- **Branch (recommended):** include the key, e.g. `agent/squidward/lcow-7-…`

Replace `LCOW-7` with the real workspace key for the issue you are working on.
